description: This file implements a command-line server for an ACP gateway, handling WebSocket connections, configuration loading, argument parsing, and process signals.

classes.name: AcpServerOptions
classes.description: Type defining options for the ACP server, including gateway URL, tokens, session info, and flags.

classes.name: GatewayClient
classes.description: Client class managing WebSocket connection to the gateway.

classes.name: AcpGatewayAgent
classes.description: Agent class handling communication over the gateway connection.

classes.name: AgentSideConnection
classes.description: Represents a side of the agent connection.

methods.name: serveAcpGateway
methods.description: Main function to start the ACP gateway server, establishing connection, handling signals, and managing the agent lifecycle.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into server options.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for the command-line tool.
